_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Golf (Geejjiba Kaardii) - Geejjibaa {player_id}.
Ka'uun: Walitti lakkoofsa xiqqoo kana raundii tokkoo keessatti argachuu. Yoo kolomiin walii qixxeessan, 0 jedhamuun walitti lakkoofsa.
Ilaalchaa Kaardii: A=1, 2-10=ilaalchaa, J/Q=10, K=0

Raawwiilee (tuqaalee akka-jiruutti fayyadami):
- '[draw]' - Kuusaa irraa kaardii fuudhu
- '[take]' - Kaardii kuusa irraa fuudhu
- '[swap X Y]' - Kaardii fuudhamee bakka X (safuu) Y (kolomii) waliin jijjiiru
- '[discard]' - Kaardii fuudhamee gubbaa kuusaa buusu

board.drew:
Ati {card} argite
Amma ati [swap X Y] ykn [discard]
board.took:
Ati {card} discard pile irraa argite
Amma ati [swap X Y] wajjin (discard maaliif)

options.must_swap: Ati: [swap X Y] (kaardiiwwan kuusaa irraa baasuu hin dandeessu)

message.knocked: Taphachiisaa {pid} dhabamsiise! taphattoonni kaanis dabaree tokko dabalataa qabu.
message.final_round: Taphataa {pid} {reason}! Taphataa kanniin biraa gara tokko deebii argata.

invalid.wrong_action: Tokkummaa bracket ilaali: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], ykn [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Kaardii kutaawwan gatii hin qabne keessaa fudhatame dhiisuu hin dandeessu. Jijjiiruu qabda.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Ati kaartii argite. Ati [swap X Y] ykn [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Kaardii wal jijjiiruudhaaf kaardii qabatamaa taʼe argachuu qabdu.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Kaardiin fudhatan qabachuun dirqama, osoo gadi buqqisuuf.
invalid.knock_with_card: Kaardii qabatteen wal rukutuun hin dandaʼamu. Duraan dursee sochii kee xumuri.
invalid.already_knocked: Namni tokko marsaa kana duraanuu ni mo'a.
